analysis.reasonEn: Price attempts to rebound near swing support at $592.60, but signals for trend reversal are weak due to current price below SMA5 ($597.15) and continued MACD histogram worsening. RSI also shows lack of direction, hovering at 40.7 in neutral territory. Trading volume is subdued at 0.44 of the 5-day average, indicating insufficient buying pressure. 4-hour RSI at 27.3 is oversold, but lacks alignment with daily/weekly indicators, reducing reliability. Unlike the overall market's QQQ surge, the stock's own momentum is weakening.
